task: Network Intrusion Detection with DIDS-MFL framework
named_method: DIDS-MFL (Disentangled Dynamic Intrusion Detection with Multi-scale Fusion Learning)

key_components.name: Statistical Disentanglement
key_components.description: Non-parametric MI-based feature weighting to separate entangled feature distributions
key_components.fidelity_notes: Approximated SMT optimization with MI/correlation ratio; faithful to 3D-IDS concept

key_components.name: Representational Disentanglement
key_components.description: Memory module + decorrelation loss to highlight attack-specific features
key_components.implementation: MemoryModule (read from class-specific memory) + corrcoef-based decorrelation loss

key_components.name: Dynamic Graph Diffusion
key_components.description: Spatiotemporal aggregation via graph diffusion on evolving data streams
key_components.implementation: Temporal encoding + spatial diffusion layer combination
key_components.fidelity_notes: Simplified from full multi-layer graph diffusion; uses node-level temporal encoding

key_components.name: Multi-scale Representation Fusion
key_components.description: Multiple representation scales for few-shot learning enhancement
key_components.implementation: MultiScaleFusion with 3 scale branches (32, 64, 96 dims) + fusion layer
key_components.fidelity_notes: Inspired by BSNet bi-similarity concept; extended to multi-scale
